name: acme-medusa-basic-app
description: ACME Medusa v2 Basic Core Backend Demo

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.resolve('./node_modules/@medusajs/medusa/node_modules/@medusajs/draft-order'); const dst = path.resolve('./node_modules/@medusajs/draft-order'); if (fs.existsSync(src) && !fs.existsSync(dst)) fs.symlinkSync(src, dst, 'junction');"
